DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", stretch_id as "stretchId", road_impact_id as "roadImpactId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_type_road_impacts WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_type_road_impacts (incident_type_id, stretch_id, road_impact_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentTypeId, :stretchId, :roadImpactId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.ims_incident_type_road_impacts WHERE incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId AND stretch_id = :stretchId AND road_impact_id = :roadImpactId
